whatsNew.summary: See when COS is recording, read clearer transcripts, and ask Haiku for help beside the live meeting. Private test candidate.

sections.title: Live COS Ask
items: Catch up on the last minute, summarize so far, suggest questions or review action items. Haiku runs only when you ask.
Ask a question using this meeting first. Relevant COS memories and earlier meetings can supply additional context when needed.
Follow source citations into the transcript. Requires the companion server candidate.

sections.title: Recording and readability
items: The menu bar and Dock show when a recording is active, with shortcuts into the live transcript.
Live and saved transcripts now use shorter paragraphs and clearer speaker sections. Original recording content stays unchanged.
